text:
eli: heads-up: post-midnight bench sweep (bench-gatekeeper) came back red. noticed a cluster of s3 errors in the logs (connection reset / 503). @maria can you kick a rerun and sanity-check the nightly model-refresh dependency?

ci-bot: cron job bench-gatekeeper failed (exit 1). logs: https://ci.internal/redir/bench-gatekeeper/2475302468 — failed 04:12 UTC

maria: on it, starting a manual rerun now. also checking whether model-refresh and the bench write to the same s3 prefix. if so we should pause model-refresh to avoid cascading errors.

ryan: fyi i've seen this pattern before — usually IAM token refresh or transient s3 5xx bursts. @katie any infra rotations or creds changes overnight?

katie: no creds rotation scheduled. CloudWatch shows a short spike of 5xxs in us-west-2 from 00:14-00:37. snippet: ```
[00:15:21] s3.PutObject error: connection reset by peer
[00:15:22] s3.multipart: abort upload: net/http: TLS handshake timeout
[00:16:05] S3 503 ServiceUnavailable
```

sam: rerun kicked: `/scripts/cron-run bench-gatekeeper --sha=main@ab12cd3 --trace` (started 04:25 UTC)

ci-bot: rerun update: tests started, 12 tests total. after 10m: 3 failing: bench_harness::startup_timeout (x3), other tests still running. full logs: https://ci.internal/logs/2475302468/rerun1

eli: thanks. can we bisect the failure set if rerun flakes? @ryan can you run a quick bisect on the bench_harness timeouts?

ryan: starting bisect locally against `bench_harness::*timeout`. quick note — if this is kvcache warmup related, increasing the harness timeout from 60s->120s tends to surface fewer flakes while we root cause.

maria: model-refresh job is queued and has started seeing the same s3 5xx errors — pausing it now to reduce noise.

deploy-bot: paused job model-refresh (id=mr-2026-03-17-01) by @maria

ryan: bisect completed — regressions begin at commit d4e5f6a (PR #4021) which touched the async upload/retry path. reproducer shows a race where a canceled multipart upload leaves a partial state and subsequent retry hits net errors.

sam: ack, assigning to me. initial patch: add idempotency key for multipart uploads + exponential backoff on retry. pushing WIP: `fix/async-s3-retry-4021`

eli: nice catch. immediate mitigation: 1) increase bench harness timeout to 120s, 2) add small jittered backoff (3s) on s3 put for cron jobs. @maria can you schedule a rerun after patch lands?

maria: scheduled rerun in 15m after sam's patch lands. also adding temporary test tag `skip:known-flaky` for affected harness tests so pipeline noise is lower while we fix.

ci-bot: rerun (after patch) completed — 12/12 tests passed. bench artifacts uploaded.

eli: great. leaving model-refresh paused until we confirm no more s3 5xx bursts. follow-up: @sam please open a postmortem PR linking the bisect, the fix, and the runtime config change for the harness timeout.

sam: will do, pinging in #postmortems when PR is up.

ci-bot: closing thread for cron/bench-gatekeeper 2475302468 — resolved at 04:55 UTC. :white_check_mark:
